text: Open pillar:live bead jev-n4-recover-error-rule-1grh.1 is unreachable from the mission root. The root depends on its N4 parent jev-n4-recover-error-rule-1grh, but that parent does not depend on .1; the root's acceptance can therefore pass its listed prerequisites while this live leaf remains open.
evidence: r4 issues.jsonl: jev-n4-recover-error-rule-1grh.1.status=open, labels=[pillar:live], dependencies=[]; jev-n4-recover-error-rule-1grh.dependencies omit .1; jev-q3q8's transitive dependency closure omits .1. Same root-omission substance is recorded in r3/L1-CyanPeak.jsonl row 3.
fix: Add a blocking path from jev-q3q8 to .1, directly or through its N4 parent, and require every open bead to be reachable from the root.

text: The measured-pillar ledger acceptance permits a claimed-ON live surface to remain UNMEASURED while the bead passes: criterion 2 accepts UNMEASURED as a verdict, and no criterion requires every live surface to have a value-minus-cost receipt before the measured pillar can pass. The mission requires that receipt for every live surface.
evidence: ROADMAP.md:25; r4 issues.jsonl jev-mvvh.acceptance_criteria item 2 explicitly permits KEEP / KILL / UNMEASURED, while item 5 gates only KILL surfaces being OFF and does not reject live UNMEASURED rows.
fix: Make the measured-pillar pass fail while any claimed-ON surface is UNMEASURED; require a value-minus-cost receipt or evidenced OFF/REFUTED disposition for each surface.

text: The mission promises that the shared CLI makes the next classifier cheap, but no acceptance measures the marginal effort or cost of adding a family. The stranger-adoption bar measures installing and running a family in another project, not adding a new family to the CLI.
evidence: ROADMAP.md:9-10; r4 issues.jsonl jev-r1vp.acceptance_criteria item 2 measures elapsed minutes for adoption in a fresh project; jev-b35c.2 acceptance tests registry generation and errors but has no family-addition effort/cost measure; jev-uzq1 acceptance does not measure that promise.
fix: Add a bounded, reproducible next-family change receipt with a committed baseline and time/effort threshold, or remove the unmeasured claim from the mission.

text: The in-progress honest-pillar gate has an empty acceptance_criteria field, so its required result has no runnable proof contract even though jev-q3q8 directly depends on it.
evidence: r4 issues.jsonl jev-oh7c.status=in_progress, labels=[pillar:honest], acceptance_criteria is empty; jev-q3q8.dependencies include jev-oh7c.
fix: Specify executable positive and negative cases, the required source/seed references and replay pass criterion, plus non-author verification.
